svg.title: DECLIC
svg.desc: professional · confidential. Declaring and cataloguing connected scientific instruments. A 4-step declaration flow, with moderation before publication. Catalogue of 53 LoRaWAN instrument models. Built with React 18, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, OIDC.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
